title: CriteriaTrialResponse
description: core API -> BFF output for the criteria hearing (ADR-165 D3 / D6). Candidate cells with their actual values, every end user's interest per category, and the assessment of a proposed line. Only facts the solver decided ride the wire: no total score (how weights combine is the solver's idea), no faces or colours (the client derives the gap against an expectation — closed form), no verdict of which candidate is best. Wire form uses camelCase.

candidates.description: Candidate cells, in a stable order. Zero is a legitimate answer (the solver has nothing to show) and is not the same as the solver being unreachable.

interest.description: Exactly one row per (sent end user × category D/Q/C/S). The owner of a row is its `actor`: the formula and the weights behind it are vouched for by that person (ADR-165 D6).

id.description: Deterministic: the same cell answers with the same id on every call.

actuals.description: One actual value per element — all seven.

basis.description: Where the value came from. nominal = the solver's curated cell type (with a range); derived = computed from the scene's geometry; declared = a person overrode it with a quote or a measurement.

range.description: [low, high] the value may really fall in. Absent = the value is exact for this basis.

value.description: How much this person's line in this category is deciding the outcome now (0 = slack, 1 = the most decisive line in this line set).

proposalAssessment.description: Closed kind-discriminated union. `evaluated` with no offerings = inside the margin.

baseline.description: Candidate id the solver keeps under the current line.

proposed.description: Candidate id the solver keeps under the proposed line.

offerings.description: What the change gives up: per end user (the proposer included), each element whose actual value gets worse against that person's current expectation. Empty = inside the margin.

oneOf.description: No candidate meets the proposed line.
No candidate meets the current line, so there is nothing to give up from.
